messages:
Ivy K: Quick thread  we need to finalize rollout behaviour for the regional fallback flags before EU launch. Main worry: stale client caches after a server rollback.
Marco D: Agree. Web TTLs are ~60s, mobile 5m. Some embedded SDKs can't poll.
Ellen Z: Proposal: introduce a signed region flush token + two classes of flags: soft (5m) and emergency (15s + token poll). Emergency flags opt-in per client.
Ivy K: How does the token work in practice?
Marco D: Control plane rotates token. SDKs poll /tokens/region every N sec (configurable). On mismatch SDK immediately re-fetch flags and apply emergency semantics. Default N=30s for emergency flags.
Ellen Z: For offline clients: on reconnect SDK must force revalidate once. Also add session affinity on server so old clients aren't pinned to new variants beyond a short window.
Ivy K: Telemetry we need: token_last_check, token_mismatch_count, flag_refresh_lag_p95, decision_source. Surface token_mismatch_p95 per region in console.
Marco D: Rollout stages: 0) shadow baseline; 1) 2% server routing; 2) 5% server routing + token polling for cohort; 3) client emergency flag flips for chosen cohorts; 4) ramp. Hold 2h per stage and watch gating signals.
Ellen Z: Rollback ladder: rotate token -> push emergency flag off -> server routing -> global kill. Each step audited and idempotent.
Ivy K: Security: tokens signed with HMAC; rotate endpoint requires 2FA ops group and creates audit entry. Private installs can set poll interval locally. Document tradeoffs.
Marco D: Devex: small CLI to simulate stale clients and token delays for staging: ri-flagsim --region eu --delay 600.
ops-bot: created RFC RFC-flush-token-2026 and stubbed rotate endpoint (audit + signer).
Ivy K: Action items: Marco -> token poll spec + console metrics (48h). Ellen -> SDK opt-in and reconnect revalidate (72h). ops-bot -> finalize rotate endpoint + audit (24h). We'll run staging dry-run once done. :rocket:
